title: What Happens During an HCPC FTP Investigation? Emotional and Legal Insights - Fitness to Practise

sentences.en: In this episode, I'm joined by a legal expert to explore what psychologists need to know before the HCPC comes knocking.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我邀请了一位法律专家，共同探讨在HCPC找上门之前，心理学家需要了解的事项。

sentences.en: Whether you're under investigation, you're concerned about someone else's practice, or you just want to feel more prepared, this conversation is well worth staying tuned for.
sentences.zh: 无论你目前正在接受调查、对其他人的执业情况感到担忧，还是只是想让自己更有备无患，这场对话都非常值得收听。

sentences.zh: 希望你觉得超级有用。

sentences.zh: 欢迎收听“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Now, in order to be able to say that to you, it means that in the UK, I am registered and regulated with and by what's called the HCPC,
sentences.zh: 现在，为了能够对你这么说，这意味着在英国，我是在由所谓的HCPC注册并受其监管的，

sentences.en: which comes with a whole set of standards, protocols and guidance.
sentences.zh: 这就伴随着一整套标准、协议和指导原则。

sentences.en: But what happens if people do not stick to their professional codes of conduct?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果有人不遵守他们的职业行为准则会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: What happens if things get a bit wobbly?
sentences.zh: 如果事情变得有点动摇会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, we do have a regulatory body for a reason.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们设立监管机构是有原因的。

sentences.en: And today, we are taking a deep dive into that process.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将深入探讨这个流程。

sentences.en: So with no further ado, let's cut to our chat and I will catch you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 那么闲话少说，让我们直接切入访谈，我们在另一端见。

sentences.en: I just want to welcome along our guest for today, Nicholas Sterkling.
sentences.zh: 我只想欢迎我们今天的嘉宾尼古拉斯·斯特克林。

sentences.en: Hi, Nicholas.
sentences.zh: 嗨，尼古拉斯。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: How are you going?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm really well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我非常好，谢谢。

sentences.en: I hope you are well, too.
sentences.zh: 希望你也一切都好。

sentences.en: So thank you for pitching this podcast episode to me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你向我推荐这期播客节目。

sentences.en: Could you firstly tell us, in case people are not aware, what or who are the HCPC?
sentences.zh: 你能首先告诉我们，以防大家不太了解，HCPC是什么，或者谁是HCPC吗？

sentences.en: Okay, so the Health and Care Professions Council is a regulatory body.
sentences.zh: 好的，健康与护理专业委员会是一个监管机构。

sentences.en: So it's actually a statutory body, meaning it's created by a government statute, which is governed health care professionals.
sentences.zh: 所以它实际上是一个法定机构，意味着它是通过政府法令创建的，负责管理医疗保健专业人员。

sentences.en: Now, there's about 14 different professions that it governs.
sentences.zh: 目前它管辖着大约14种不同的专业。

sentences.en: It used to govern social workers as well, which is a big one, but that now is governed by Social Work England.
sentences.zh: 它过去也管辖社会工作者，这是一个很大的群体，但现在由英格兰社会工作局负责监管。

sentences.en: So essentially, if you're in contact with someone in relation to your health, outside of nurses and doctors, the person you're in contact with is likely governed by the HCPC.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，如果你接触到与你的健康相关的人，除了护士和医生之外，与你接触的人很可能都受HCPC监管。

sentences.en: So it's a regulator with government powers.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一个拥有政府权力的监管机构。

sentences.en: And the reason why that's useful to understand is that if the HCPC requests a document as a regulator,
sentences.zh: 理解这一点很有用，因为如果HCPC作为监管机构要求提供一份文件，

sentences.en: they do have the powers of government, meaning that they can make sure that you give it to them.
sentences.zh: 他们确实拥有政府权力，这意味着他们能够确保你把文件交出来。

sentences.en: It's been around for quite a while now.
sentences.zh: 它已经存在相当长一段时间了。

sentences.en: It used to be called the HCP.
sentences.zh: 它过去被称为HCP。

sentences.en: It's a body that I think it's worth understanding just from the outset.
sentences.zh: 我认为从一开始就有必要了解这个机构。

sentences.en: It's a body that's essentially set up to protect the public.
sentences.zh: 它本质上是一个旨在保护公众的机构。

sentences.en: Now, as a psychologist or another health care professional, your dealings with the HCPC can often be a little bit negative, meaning that they're asking for money.
sentences.zh: 现在，作为一名心理学家或其他医疗保健专业人员，你与HCPC的打交道往往有点负面，这意味着他们是在要钱。

sentences.en: They're raising fees, which is a common complaint.
sentences.zh: 他们在提高费用，这是一个常见的抱怨。

sentences.en: But essentially, if we understand that the purpose of the HCPC is as a public protection body.
sentences.zh: 但本质上，如果我们理解HCPC的目的是作为一个公众保护机构。

sentences.en: So it's there essentially to make sure that those people that you work with, at fellow psychologists, or if you're working within the NHS,
sentences.zh: 所以它的存在基本上是为了确保与你合作的那些人，无论是同行心理学家，还是如果你在NHS工作，

sentences.en: a radiologist or a podiatrist or a paramedic, that they are of particular standards.
sentences.zh: 放射科医生、足病医师还是急救护理人员，他们都符合特定的标准。

sentences.en: So what we really want as a society, I think, is people knowing how to do their jobs.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为作为一个社会，我们真正想要的是人们知道如何做好他们的工作。

sentences.en: So there'll be various standards that each person has to meet in order to be able to be registered by the HCPC.
sentences.zh: 因此，每个人都必须达到各种标准，才能获得HCPC的注册资格。

sentences.en: So I think overall, it's a really positive idea how it's actually how they perform their duties
sentences.zh: 所以总的来说，我认为这是一个非常积极的想法，至于他们实际上如何履行职责

sentences.en: can be difficult for people to understand sometimes.
sentences.zh: 有时人们可能很难理解。

sentences.en: It can often be underfunded, meaning that people, if a complaint's raised against someone, it can take a long time to process.
sentences.zh: 它往往资金不足，这意味着如果有人针对某人提出投诉，处理起来可能需要很长时间。

sentences.en: You may have different case managers.
sentences.zh: 你可能会遇到不同的案件经理。

sentences.en: So you can become quite frustrated with them.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会对他们感到相当沮丧。

sentences.en: But overall, it's a body there to protect the public.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，它是一个旨在保护公众的机构。

sentences.en: I think that's the best way of analysing it.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是分析它的最佳方式。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And is it all funded by the people it's regulated?
sentences.zh: 那么它的资金全部来自它所监管的人员吗？

sentences.en: Or is there some funding from government, for example?
sentences.zh: 还是说有一些来自政府的资金，比如？

sentences.en: That might be a question you don't know the answer, but I just, yeah, I wondered that.
sentences.zh: 这可能是你不知道答案的问题，但我只是，是的，我很好奇这一点。

sentences.en: My understanding is it's primarily funded and almost exclusively funded by its members.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，它主要甚至几乎完全由其会员提供资金。

sentences.en: I mean, I wouldn't absolutely quote me on that, but from my experience having worked with the HCPC, that's the understanding staff have.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你不能完全以此断言，但根据我与HCPC合作的经验，这是工作人员的共识。

sentences.en: And as you guys are obviously well aware, psychologists who are listening, it costs a fair bit of money to be a member of the HCPC.
sentences.zh: 正如大家显然很清楚的那样，正在收听节目的心理学家们，成为HCPC的会员需要花一大笔钱。

sentences.en: So that's, in theory, where your money is going.
sentences.zh: 所以从理论上讲，这就是你的钱去向的地方。

sentences.en: I mean, there are shareholders and the like, but essentially it's there for the good of its own professions.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那里有股东之类的人，但本质上它是为了其所属行业自身的利益而存在的。

sentences.en: Yeah, so it's not there to make money.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以它不是为了赚钱而存在的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But that said, if anyone's listening to this and you are working in the UK and you're using one of the protected titles as a psychologist,
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，如果收听节目的任何人都在英国工作，并且正在使用心理学家的受保护头衔之一，

sentences.en: that would be, for example, clinical psychologist, counselling psychologist, forensic psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 例如临床心理学家、咨询心理学家、法医心理学家。

sentences.en: There's a few more as well, but those are protected titles.
sentences.zh: 还有其他一些头衔，但这些都是受保护的头衔。

sentences.en: And if you have that qualification, you're using that title, you must be registered and regulated by the HCPC.
sentences.zh: 如果你拥有该资格并使用该头衔，你必须在HCPC注册并受其监管。

sentences.en: This is not optional.
sentences.zh: 这不是可选的。

sentences.en: And actually, if you see somebody using one of those titles and you don't think that they are appropriately qualified in this country to be using that, you can contact the HCPC
sentences.zh: 实际上，如果你看到有人使用这些头衔，并且你认为他们在国内没有具备适当的资格来使用该头衔，你可以联系HCPC

sentences.en: to kind of make some inquiries about whether that person is acting with integrity, should we say.
sentences.zh: 来做一些查询，比如这个人是否可以说行事正直。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I am registered with the HCPC, which means that I will get renewal documents once a year.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我在HCPC注册了，这意味着我每年会收到一次续期文件。

sentences.en: So that's when they drop into my email inbox.
sentences.zh: 这就是它们落入我电子邮箱的时候。

sentences.en: I will get information about payments when they're due, when I've paid them.
sentences.zh: 我会收到有关付款的信息，包括何时到期以及我何时付款。

sentences.en: Sometimes people get told that they have got to do a CPD audit, continuing professional development.
sentences.zh: 有时人们会被告知他们必须进行CPD（持续专业发展）审核。

sentences.en: But one other time when people might hear from the HCPC might be if they have had a fitness to practice issue lodged against them.
sentences.zh: 但人们可能会听到来自HCPC的另一个时间点可能是，如果他们被提出了执业资格存疑的问题。

sentences.en: But as you are going to tell us later, you can actually also do that yourself.
sentences.zh: 但正如你稍后要告诉我们的那样，你实际上也可以自己做这件事。

sentences.en: You can nominate yourself for that.
sentences.zh: 你可以为此提名自己。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit about what this fitness to practice process is like, please, Nick?
sentences.zh: 尼克，你能给我们讲讲这个执业资格审核流程是什么样的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it's something that I think it's very relevant for all people regulated by the HCPC to have a general understanding of.
sentences.zh: 好的，我的意思是，我认为所有受HCPC监管的人对这一点有一个大致的了解是非常相关的。

sentences.en: And I'm always quite not surprised anymore, but it's always interesting to note that a lot of people, even very experienced people,
sentences.zh: 我总是对一件事不再感到惊讶，但注意到很多人，甚至是经验非常丰富的人，总是很有趣，

sentences.en: have very little knowledge about the fitness to practice process.
sentences.zh: 他们对执业资格审核流程知之甚少。

sentences.en: So I sometimes run webinars and we have some very experienced heads of hospitals, psychologists particularly,
sentences.zh: 所以我有时会举办网络研讨会，我们有一些非常有经验的医院负责人，尤其是心理学家，

sentences.en: and they will have what I would argue is a very limited understanding of it because they haven't really encountered it that much yet.
sentences.zh: 他们对这方面的理解可以说是非常有限的，因为他们实际上还没怎么遇到过。

sentences.en: And then they encounter it and it becomes quite clear to them that, well, I probably should have known a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 然后他们遇到了，就很清楚地发现，嗯，我可能应该多了解一点。

sentences.en: So the fitness to practice process is about protecting someone's fitness to practice, meaning protecting society,
sentences.zh: 因此，执业资格审核流程是关于保护某人执业资格的，也就是保护社会，

sentences.en: society's desire to have people who do their profession do it competently.
sentences.zh: 社会希望从事某个职业的人能够胜任他们的工作。

sentences.en: So there are various standards of proficiency.
sentences.zh: 因此有各种能力标准。

sentences.en: There are various standards that all registrants need to uphold.
sentences.zh: 所有注册人员都需要维护各种标准。

sentences.en: And if you don't uphold these standards, the idea is essentially in a very broad, simplistic sense, is that you will be held to account.
sentences.zh: 如果你不维护这些标准，从一个非常广泛、简化的意义上讲，这个想法基本上就是你将承担责任。

sentences.en: The fitness to practice regime is run by the HCPC, meaning that people can make complaints.
sentences.zh: 执业资格审核机制由HCPC运营，这意味着人们可以提出投诉。

sentences.en: Various members of the public make complaints.
sentences.zh: 社会各界人士都会提出投诉。

sentences.en: And in terms of a percentage, it's worthwhile understanding who makes these complaints against a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 就百分比而言，了解是谁针对心理学家提出这些投诉是很有意义的。

sentences.en: So the overwhelming majority of complaints are raised by members of the public.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数投诉都是由公众成员提出的。

sentences.en: So they can be clients.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可能是客户。

sentences.en: They can be someone who's read an article that you've written, as I say, as a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 他们可能是读过你写的一篇文章的人，正如我所说，作为一名心理学家。

sentences.en: They've seen you on the television for more experienced ones.
sentences.zh: 对于经验更丰富的人来说，他们可能在电视上看到过你。

sentences.en: They've heard, seen your social media posts.
sentences.zh: 他们听过、看过你在社交媒体上的发帖。

sentences.en: A member of the public that doesn't necessarily have to be directly related to you in the sense that was your patient, was your colleague.
sentences.zh: 公众成员不一定非得与你直接相关，比如曾是你的病人或是你的同事。

sentences.en: So the member of the public is the great majority.
sentences.zh: 所以公众成员占了绝大多数。

sentences.en: Other colleagues is another, I think about 20% of cases are raised by other colleagues.
sentences.zh: 其他同事是另一个来源，我认为大约20%的案件是由其他同事提出的。

sentences.en: So people who work with you, your boss, your workmate.
sentences.zh: 也就是与你共事的人、你的老板、你的同事。

sentences.en: And then there are also anonymous complaints.
sentences.zh: 此外还有匿名投诉。

sentences.en: There's a small amount that happen.
sentences.zh: 有一小部分是这种情况。

sentences.en: So you can have anonymous complaints.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会遇到匿名投诉。

sentences.en: The HCPC generally prefers not to receive anonymous complaints, but in certain circumstances that can happen.
sentences.zh: HCPC通常倾向于不接收匿名投诉，但在某些情况下这可能会发生。

sentences.en: But I think we're talking about 2% or 3%.
sentences.zh: 但我想我们讨论的是2%或3%。

sentences.en: Obviously where the protection of a person who's involved in the complaint is prima facie more important than identifying them.
sentences.zh: 显然，在某些情况下，保护涉诉人员的利益在表面上比查明他们的身份更重要。

sentences.en: But essentially the purpose of the fitness to practice investigation, the HCPC needs to be able to tell the person who the complaint's raised against, who's raising the complaint.
sentences.zh: 但从根本上讲，出于执业资格调查的目的，HCPC需要能够告诉被投诉人是谁提出了投诉。

sentences.en: So therefore they can prepare properly on how to respond to that complaint.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们可以妥善准备如何回应这起投诉。

sentences.en: The final way a complaint is raised is a self-referral.
sentences.zh: 提出投诉的最后一种方式是自我转介。

sentences.en: Now this is quite common and people are often quite surprised by that.
sentences.zh: 现在这很常见，人们对此往往感到相当惊讶。

sentences.en: So issues related to health, often people will self-refer.
sentences.zh: 因此，与健康相关的问题，人们经常会进行自我转介。

sentences.en: That may be health in the broad sense of physical health.
sentences.zh: 这可能是广义上的身体健康方面的健康。

sentences.en: That may be health in the sense that there's an addiction issue.
sentences.zh: 这可能是存在成瘾问题意义上的健康。

sentences.en: So having an understanding that you're unable to practice competently and then raising that concern with the HCPC.
sentences.zh: 也就是认识到自己无法胜任执业，然后向HCPC提出这一担忧。

sentences.en: So filling out a document and sending it to the HCPC or calling one of their numbers and explaining that actually I can't do this for reason A, I have cancer.
sentences.zh: 也就是填写一份文件并发送给HCPC，或者拨打他们的电话号码之一，解释说实际上由于A原因我做不到这一点，我得了癌症。

sentences.en: Reason B, I'm suffering from substance abuse.
sentences.zh: B原因，我正在遭受药物滥用的困扰。

sentences.en: And being honest and transparent in that process is really helpful from the HCPC's perspective.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中保持诚实和透明从HCPC的角度来看是非常有帮助的。

sentences.en: And that'll also reflect well upon you as you move forward.
sentences.zh: 这也将在你向前迈进的过程中为你带来良好的声誉。

sentences.en: So once a complaint is raised against you, you then can have a three-stage sort of process.
sentences.zh: 因此，一旦针对你提出投诉，你就会经历一个大致分为三个阶段的流程。

sentences.en: So a complaint will be raised and will be dealt with by triage,
sentences.zh: 首先会提出投诉，并由分诊处进行处理，

sentences.en: whereby there's people in an office at the HCPC will determine whether there's anything at all within this complaint.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，HCPC办公室的工作人员将确定该投诉中是否存在任何问题。

sentences.en: If there is, then it'll move to the investigation stage.
sentences.zh: 如果有，那么它将进入调查阶段。

sentences.en: Now the investigation stage is probably where most people have contact with it.
sentences.zh: 现在，调查阶段可能是大多数人接触该流程的阶段。

sentences.en: So for example, if a complaint is raised against you, you'll receive an email or a letter defining what the complaint is and the fact that there is an investigation underway.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果针对你提出投诉，你将收到一封电子邮件或信件，说明投诉内容以及调查正在进行的事实。

sentences.en: That investigation process can last anywhere between two months to three, four years, ideally the shortest spectrum, but it can take a longer process.
sentences.zh: 该调查过程可能持续两个月到三、四年不等，理想情况下时间最短，但也可能需要更长的时间。

sentences.en: Then the decision is made whether this will go to an ICP, it's an investigation committee panel, and they will determine whether that will then go to a final hearing.
sentences.zh: 然后决定这是否会提交给ICP（调查委员会小组），他们将决定是否随后举行最终听证会。

sentences.en: Now most cases are closed far before it reaches an ICP.
sentences.zh: 大多数案件在到达ICP之前很久就已经关闭了。

sentences.en: If it does reach an ICP, an investigation committee panel, and they decide there is a case to answer, that will then go to a final hearing panel,
sentences.zh: 如果它确实到达了ICP（调查委员会小组），并且他们决定有案情需要回应，那么它将提交给最终听证小组，

sentences.en: which is a longer process and it's similar to a court.
sentences.zh: 这是一个更长的过程，类似于法庭。

sentences.en: So it's a tribunal essentially whereby a thorough examination of the evidence will go forward.
sentences.zh: 所以它本质上是一个法庭，将对证据进行彻底审查。

sentences.en: And it's only generally for misconduct cases that it will reach that higher level.
sentences.zh: 而且通常只有失职案件才会达到这个更高的级别。

sentences.en: And if it goes to that higher level, then the various sanctions available are a strike-off, a warning, these sort of ideas or these sort of sanctions.
sentences.zh: 如果它上升到那个更高的级别，那么可用的各种制裁措施包括除名、警告，这类意见或这类制裁。

sentences.en: So it's worth understanding that less than 1% of cases will go to a final hearing.
sentences.zh: 因此值得理解的是，不到1%的案件会进入最终听证会。

sentences.en: And as a registered psychologist in the UK, there are 30,000 members,
sentences.zh: 作为英国的注册心理学家，有30000名会员，

sentences.en: 0.06% of psychologists will have a sanction against them through the HCPC.
sentences.zh: 0.06%的心理学家会通过HCPC受到制裁。

sentences.en: So this is a very small number.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常小的数字。

sentences.en: However, there are also, it's worth understanding that in any given year between 200 and 250 cases are raised against psychologists,
sentences.zh: 然而，同样值得理解的是，在任何给定的年份里，针对心理学家的投诉案多达200到250起，

sentences.en: which is first or second in terms of the 14 professions the HCPC govern.
sentences.zh: 在HCPC管辖的14个行业中，这排名第一或第二。

sentences.en: So it is the second most complained against profession.
sentences.zh: 所以它是被投诉最多的第二大行业。

sentences.en: And that for me is a very interesting point because it sort of reflects on the nature of the profession itself.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是一个非常有趣的观点，因为它在某种程度上反映了这个行业本身的性质。

sentences.en: Why do psychologists have more complaints raised against them?
sentences.zh: 为什么心理学家会收到更多的投诉？

sentences.en: And that's something we might be able to discuss later.
sentences.zh: 这可能是我们稍后可以讨论的事情。

sentences.en: But essentially, it's worth understanding that if you're a psychologist, your chance of being struck off are very, very, very small if you're doing the right thing
sentences.zh: 但本质上，值得理解的是，如果你是一名心理学家，如果你在做正确的事情，你被除名的几率非常、非常、非常小

sentences.en: and just as a percentage.
sentences.zh: 而且仅仅从百分比来看也是如此。

sentences.en: However, there are 235 to 250 cases raised annually against psychologists.
sentences.zh: 然而，每年针对心理学家提出的投诉案有235到250起。

sentences.en: So your chance of having some involvement with the FTP process is not negligible.
sentences.zh: 因此，你与FTP流程产生某种牵连的几率并非微不足道。

sentences.en: Whether you're actually involved as a complainant against a colleague, whether you have a complaint raised against you, whether you're involved in the process
sentences.zh: 无论您是作为对同事的投诉人实际参与其中，还是有人对您提出投诉，又或是您参与了相关流程

sentences.en: as writing a professional report or appearing as a witness.
sentences.zh: 比如撰写专业报告或作为证人出庭。

sentences.en: So it's worth understanding how it operates.
sentences.zh: 因此，了解它的运作方式是非常有价值的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And it sounds like a very multi-layered process, but I guess what you're saying is the first thing you may know about this if this is not a self-disclosure
sentences.zh: 听起来这是一个多层次的过程，不过我想您的意思是，如果这不是主动披露，您可能了解到的第一件事

sentences.en: is you're going about your normal day, you open your emails and then suddenly it feels like the world perhaps implodes a little bit because somebody,
sentences.zh: 就是当您正在过着平常的一天，打开电子邮件时，突然间会感觉世界好像有点崩塌了，因为某个,

sentences.en: which might be an anonymous complainant or it might be someone that's named in that email has raised a fitness to practice concern.
sentences.zh: 可能是匿名的投诉人，也可能是该邮件中点名的人，提出了关于执业资格的关切。

sentences.en: Now, of course, that's going to feel probably incredibly derailing, especially if you didn't see it coming at all.
sentences.zh: 现在，当然，这可能会让人感到极其崩溃，尤其是如果您完全没有预料到的话。

sentences.en: This is going to have a big emotional impact, isn't it, Nicholas?
sentences.zh: 这会带来巨大的情感冲击，对吧，尼古拉斯？

sentences.en: I mean, it's worth noting that outside of imprisonment, your profession really defines who you are.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，值得一提的是，除了监禁之外，您的职业真正定义了您是谁。

sentences.en: So if you think of sanctions in a criminal sense, and I've worked in criminal law and regulatory law,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果您从刑事意义上的制裁来考虑，而且我曾在刑法和监管法领域工作过，

sentences.en: outside of restricting your freedom, restricting your ability to practice your profession is probably the second most powerful thing an organisation can do.
sentences.zh: 除了限制您的自由之外，限制您从事职业的能力可能是机构能采取的第二大最有力的措施。

sentences.en: So that can be the most destabilising process.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是最具破坏稳定性的过程。

sentences.en: And, you know, particularly in my experience, having worked for quite a few years, primarily with psychologists, psychologists are often well equipped
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，特别是在我的经验中，工作了相当长的一段时间，主要与心理学家合作，心理学家通常具备良好的能力

sentences.en: to deal with these sort of issues through their training.
sentences.zh: 通过他们的培训来处理这类问题。

sentences.en: I mean, in theory, you guys should have some sort of knowledge about how we deal with the various processes and very skilled techniques we can use to process anxiety
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，理论上，你们应该对我们如何处理各种流程以及我们可以用来处理焦虑的非常熟练的技巧有所了解

sentences.en: or feeling unable to control a situation.
sentences.zh: 或者感到无法控制局势。

sentences.en: So I think what happens when an FTP process, a concern is raised against someone, all your sense of self can be completely rocked.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为当执业资格流程启动，有人对某人提出关切时，你的整个自我意识可能会彻底受到冲击。

sentences.en: And particularly with the length of the process, the nature of the concerns, these things can go for a long time.
sentences.zh: 特别是考虑到流程的漫长、关切的性质，这些事情可能会持续很长时间。

sentences.en: And all you're going to get is a letter in the mail saying this is a concern raised against you and we'll be in touch.
sentences.zh: 而你收到的只有一封信，上面写着这是针对你提出的关切，我们会与你联系。

sentences.en: And you know what that can entail.
sentences.zh: 你知道这意味着什么。

sentences.en: You know, eventually, in theory, that can lead to being struck off.
sentences.zh: 你知道，最终在理论上，这可能会导致被除名。

sentences.en: Now that, as I've explained, is a very small percentage, but that doesn't mean it's not in your head.
sentences.zh: 正如我所解释的，这只占很小的比例，但这并不意味着它没有在你脑海中挥之不去。

sentences.en: So I try and help those I work with, and I work a lot with the ACP UK, so the Association of Clinical Psychologists UK.
sentences.zh: 所以我尝试帮助那些我共事的人，我经常与英国临床心理学家协会（ACP UK）合作。

sentences.en: And we try and navigate ways of assisting members.
sentences.zh: 我们试图寻找协助会员的方法。

sentences.en: And obviously, there's going to be various bodies that work with the various different types of psychologists.
sentences.zh: 显然，会有各种机构与不同类型的心理学家合作。

sentences.en: So I suggest that if you are a clinical psychologist, having some contact with these bodies, or if you're an educational psychologist or various different types,
sentences.zh: 所以我建议，如果您是一名临床心理学家，与这些机构保持某种联系，或者如果您是教育心理学家或不同类型的心理学家，

sentences.en: can be really useful in dealing with the process because you can't control it.
sentences.zh: 在处理这个过程时会非常有用，因为你无法控制它。

sentences.en: And it's a feeling that I don't have control of this situation.
sentences.zh: 这是一种我无法控制局面的感觉。

sentences.en: You're waiting for an email to come back.
sentences.zh: 你在等待回信的邮件。

sentences.en: So what I suggest to people to do is to try and be proactive and understand that this fitness-to-practice process is there, in theory, to protect the public.
sentences.zh: 所以我建议人们做的是，尽量采取积极主动的态度，并理解这个执业资格流程的存在，理论上是为了保护公众。

sentences.en: And while this may feel like it's attacking you, to understand that you are part of a bigger process and to try and disassociate
sentences.zh: 虽然这可能感觉像是在攻击你，但要明白你是更大流程的一部分，并尝试剥离

sentences.en: any sort of personal feelings of anger you may have, particularly if you know you've done nothing wrong.
sentences.zh: 你可能产生的任何个人愤怒情绪，尤其是当你明知自己没有做错任何事的时候。

sentences.en: And let's be fair, most cases, nothing is proven.
sentences.zh: 公平地说，在大多数情况下，没有什么会被证明是真的。

sentences.en: There's been no fault.
sentences.zh: 没有任何过失。

sentences.en: There's been no misconduct.
sentences.zh: 没有任何不当行为。

sentences.en: But the HCPC is there to rigorously check the process.
sentences.zh: 但HCPC的存在是为了严格审查这一流程。

sentences.en: So if you can try and logically think about how do I deal with this and how do I accept the fact that it's a bit out of my control, that's really the objective.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你能试着从逻辑上思考我该如何处理这件事，以及我如何接受它有点超出我控制的事实，这才是真正的目标。

sentences.en: But it is incredibly destabilising.
sentences.zh: 但这确实极其不稳定。

sentences.en: There's no two ways about it.
sentences.zh: 这是毫无疑问的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it really is.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And, you know, thinking about the things that you're going to do in order of that which you're going to do them, probably you're going to speak to someone who hopefully loves you.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，按照你要做的事情的顺序来思考你将要做的事情，你可能会和一个爱你的人谈谈。

sentences.en: You know, you're going to speak to hopefully your supervisor.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可能会和你的主管谈谈。

sentences.en: That's really important.
sentences.zh: 这真的很重要。

sentences.en: So long as it's not your supervisor who's lodged a complaint.
sentences.zh: 只要提出投诉的主管不是你的主管就行。

sentences.en: You're probably going to speak to your indemnity insurer as well.
sentences.zh: 你可能也会和你的职业责任保险公司沟通。

sentences.en: Would that be a good thing to do, Nicholas?
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯，这样做是个好主意吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: I mean, in that order.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就按这个顺序。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: So supervision and the supervision is really, as I'm sure everyone's aware, is integral to the whole profession.
sentences.zh: 所以督导，正如我确信每个人都知道的那样，是整个行业不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: And having a supervisor you have a great working relationship with is really important.
sentences.zh: 拥有一个与你保持良好工作关系的主管非常重要。

sentences.en: And particularly if something like this arises.
sentences.zh: 特别是当出现类似情况时。

sentences.en: So the first things first is your supervisor.
sentences.zh: 所以首先要做的是找你的主管。

sentences.en: If you have a body that you're involved in, similar to the ACP UK, it is worthwhile potentially contacting them.
sentences.zh: 如果你参与了类似ACP UK这样的机构，潜在地联系他们是值得的。

sentences.en: A lot of these bodies have fitness to practice advice centres.
sentences.zh: 许多这类机构都设有执业资格咨询中心。

sentences.en: So there'll be someone there to talk to about the case.
sentences.zh: 因此会有专人与你讨论这个案件。

sentences.en: And this can be done in a very general sense.
sentences.zh: 这可以在非常宏观或一般性的层面上进行。

sentences.en: People have this fear, well, if I'm discussing it with a professional body, is that going to reflect poorly upon me?
sentences.zh: 人们会有这种恐惧，好吧，如果我和专业机构讨论这件事，这会不会对我的形象产生不好的影响？

sentences.en: But I'd argue, in my experience, having worked with a big professional body, quite the opposite.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，根据我的经验，在大型专业机构工作的经历恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Because a lot of these complaints, a lot of the complaints that are raised against professionals and the issues that they have in terms of dealing with the complaints are common.
sentences.zh: 因为很多投诉，即针对专业人士提出的许多投诉以及他们在处理投诉时遇到的问题都是常见的。

sentences.en: So if you're feeling really vulnerable and frustrated and angry, talking to someone from a representative body can be really useful.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你感到非常脆弱、沮丧和愤怒，与代表机构的人交流会非常有用。

sentences.en: And obviously your insurer.
sentences.zh: 当然还有你的保险公司。

sentences.en: And in that sense, whether you're going to get the psychological help you need,
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，无论你是否能获得所需的心理援助，

sentences.en: I'm not sure they're necessarily going to be able to provide that, but they may give you some guidelines, legal advice as well.
sentences.zh: 我不确定他们是否一定能提供，但他们可能会给你一些指导意见和法律建议。

sentences.en: So if it is a very serious matter, straight off the bat,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果这是一个非常严重的问题，从一开始，

sentences.en: it'd probably be worthwhile talking to your representative body and whether they think straight away you need to seek legal advice.
sentences.zh: 找你的代表机构谈谈，看他们是否认为你需要立即寻求法律建议，可能是值得的。

sentences.en: But try to remain calm.
sentences.zh: 但要尽量保持冷静。

sentences.en: From the outset, remain calm and realise that
sentences.zh: 从一开始就要保持冷静，并意识到

sentences.en: if you're in a 20-year career,
sentences.zh: 如果你拥有20年的职业生涯，

sentences.en: 30-year career as a psychologist, it's not impossible this is going to come against you.
sentences.zh: 或者作为心理学家有30年的职业生涯，这种情况找上门并非不可能。

sentences.en: There's going to be some sort of issue raised against you.
sentences.zh: 总会有人对你提出这样那样的问题。

sentences.en: And just accept it as part of the process and breathe.
sentences.zh: 只需接受它是流程的一部分，然后做个深呼吸。

sentences.en: That would be straight off my advice.
sentences.zh: 这就是我最初的建议。

sentences.en: Can you still continue to practise when there is an FTP hanging over you or is that very much dependent on what the allegation is?
sentences.zh: 当头顶悬着执业资格审查时，你还能继续执业吗？还是说这很大程度上取决于指控的内容？

sentences.en: Yes, you can in a simple sense.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，是的，你可以。

sentences.en: You can still work.
sentences.zh: 你仍然可以工作。

sentences.en: At this stage, nothing is proven.
sentences.zh: 在这个阶段，没有任何事情被证明。

sentences.en: You can still work unless there's an interim order application.
sentences.zh: 除非有临时命令申请，否则你仍然可以工作。

sentences.en: So in very serious cases, usually within a week or two of the HCPC receiving that complaint, they can schedule an interim order application.
sentences.zh: 因此，在非常严重的情况下，通常在HCPC收到投诉后的一到两周内，他们可以安排临时命令申请。

sentences.en: So what an interim order application is, is a very small hearing whereby the HCPC panel, which consists of three people, a chair, a layman and a member of the profession,
sentences.zh: 那么，什么是临时命令申请呢？这是一个非常小的听证会，由HCPC小组组成，该小组由三人组成，包括一名主席、一名非专业人士和一名行业成员，

sentences.en: so a psychologist, they'll make a decision whether it's safe for that person to continue practising.
sentences.zh: 也就是心理学家，他们将决定此人继续执业是否安全。

sentences.en: Now, this is not a common occurrence.
sentences.zh: 现在，这并不是常见现象。

sentences.en: It only happens in severe cases.
sentences.zh: 它只发生在严重的情况下。

sentences.en: So if they're issues of sexual assault, criminal matters, boundary issues, but of the severe kind, those sort of types of case can have intramortal applications.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果涉及性侵犯、刑事案件、越界问题，但属于严重的那一类，这类案件可能会有临时命令申请。

sentences.en: But outside of those, and you'll know very quickly if there's going to be an intramortal application and a hearing, outside of those, you are free to continue practising.
sentences.zh: 但在这些之外——如果你将面临临时命令申请和听证会，你很快就会知道——在这些之外，你可以自由继续执业。

sentences.en: Now, whether you tell your boss is a matter entirely up to you.
sentences.zh: 至于是否告诉你的老板，完全取决于你。

sentences.en: There's no legal requirement.
sentences.zh: 没有法律要求。

sentences.en: It's advisable as a legal professional.
sentences.zh: 作为专业人士，这是明智的。

sentences.en: It's advisable just because generally you guys are on the same team unless they raise the complaint against you and then they'll be well aware that it's them that's raised it.
sentences.zh: 这是明智的，因为通常你们在同一个团队，除非他们对你提出了投诉，那样他们就会非常清楚是他们提出的。

sentences.en: But generally, you are free to practise and what you say to your boss or to your colleagues is entirely up to you.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，你可以自由执业，你对老板或同事说什么完全取决于你。

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess I'm probably thinking about my own perspective too much really because I no longer work for an employer.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想我可能太多从我自己的角度去考虑了，因为我不再为雇主工作了。

sentences.en: I'm self-employed.
sentences.zh: 我是自雇职业者。

sentences.en: I don't know that in all of my time in the NHS that anyone ever said they were under an FTP or had been.
sentences.zh: 我不知道在我在NHS的整个时间里，是否有人说过他们正在接受执业资格审查或曾经接受过。

sentences.en: Is it more common in employment?
sentences.zh: 这在受雇员工中更常见吗？

sentences.en: Is it more in common in private practice or is it a real melee?
sentences.zh: 这在私人诊所更常见，还是一团乱麻？

sentences.en: In terms of what types of people have concerns raised against them, it's across the board.
sentences.zh: 就哪些类型的人会被人提出关切而言，这是普遍存在的。

sentences.en: I mean, I work at the moment with people involved in working within the NHS.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我现在和在NHS工作的人一起工作。

sentences.en: I have clients who have private practice.
sentences.zh: 我的客户有开私人诊所的。

sentences.en: I don't think there's any way of defining it.
sentences.zh: 我认为没有办法对此进行定义。

sentences.en: I mean, potentially if you're involved, for example, in the NHS,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你参与其中，例如在NHS工作，

sentences.en: you can have one complainant can make multiple complaints against various people.
sentences.zh: 你可能会遇到一个投诉人对不同的人提出多起投诉。

sentences.en: And that can happen, particularly in psychology.
sentences.zh: 这种情况确实会发生，特别是在心理学领域。

sentences.en: So that's worth understanding.
sentences.zh: 所以这是值得理解的。

sentences.en: So in that sense, there may be more complaints made by those working within broader organisations, but generally it's across the board.
sentences.zh: 因此从这个意义上说，在更广泛机构工作的人可能会提出更多投诉，但总的来说这是普遍的。

sentences.en: It's something that people and professionals as psychologists can deal with.
sentences.zh: 这是人们和作为心理学家的专业人士可以应对的事情。

sentences.en: And I'd argue, and this is something that I mentioned before,
sentences.zh: 我想说，这也是我之前提到过的一点，

sentences.en: I'd argue that the nature of the profession
sentences.zh: 我认为该行业的性质

sentences.en: dictates that vulnerable people can be involved.
sentences.zh: 决定了弱势群体可能会参与其中。

sentences.en: So as a psychologist, you're going to be working with people who need sometimes serious help.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为一名心理学家，你将与有时需要严重帮助的人合作。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's for marital issues.
sentences.zh: 有时是为了婚姻问题。

sentences.en: Obviously, there's a broad spectrum of psychology.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，心理学的范围很广。

sentences.en: But there are also some people who are unwell.
sentences.zh: 但也有一些人身体不适。

sentences.en: There's no other way to say it in the sense that there's a psychiatric disorder.
sentences.zh: 从存在心理疾病的意义上讲，没有别的说法。

sentences.en: And these types of people, patients, clients, service users, they can be referred to all three.
sentences.zh: 而这些类型的人、患者、客户、服务使用者，他们可以被引向所有这三个方面。

sentences.en: They can have a tendency to respond negatively to certain circumstances.
sentences.zh: 他们往往会对某些情况做出负面反应。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that's pretty clear for you guys as psychologists to understand.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为你们作为心理学家很容易理解这一点。

sentences.en: So in my experience, particularly during my work with the HCPC, with whom I worked for two and a half, three years before I started to work on my own.
sentences.zh: 所以在我的经验中，特别是在我与HCPC合作期间，在我开始独立工作之前，我在那里工作了两年半到三年。

sentences.en: In my experience, the HCPC receive a lot of complaints from vulnerable complainants.
sentences.zh: 根据我的经验，HCPC收到了来自弱势投诉人的大量投诉。

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess you might get someone who's paranoid, maybe who's then putting in complaints, which to them feel very justified.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想你可能会遇到一个偏执的人，也许他随后会提出投诉，对他们来说这感觉非常合理。

sentences.en: But to obviously people who are not paranoid or kind of are experiencing any psychosis symptoms that really feels like that's not at all what's happening or what has happened.
sentences.zh: 但对于那些没有偏执或者没有经历任何精神病症状的人来说，这感觉根本不是正在发生的事情，也不是曾经发生过的事情。

sentences.en: So I guess depending on what the complaint is, it might affect how you feel about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我想根据投诉的内容，它可能会影响你对此事的感受。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: I wouldn't even, paranoia and some form of schizophrenic or psychotic episode that can be people suffering from that particular condition may make complaints, but even way down
sentences.zh: 我甚至不会说，偏执和某种形式的精神分裂症或精神病发作——患有这种特定疾病的人可能会提出投诉，但即使退一步讲，

sentences.en: to a far less serious complaint, meaning someone has attachment issues and a psychologist ends a professional relationship due to the ceasing of their practice or they're moving
sentences.zh: 到一个远没有那么严重的投诉，意味着某人有依恋问题，而心理学家由于诊所关闭或搬迁而结束了专业关系

sentences.en: or for various reasons why people change,
sentences.zh: 或者由于人们改变的各种原因，

sentences.en: you know, move location and they've signposted this perfectly along the whole way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，搬了地方，他们一路上把这个路线标记得完美无缺。

sentences.en: So I'm going to be leaving in six months, nine months, exactly as you guys know how to do and when practicing professionally.
sentences.zh: 所以我要在六个月、九个月后离开，正如你们作为专业执业时所知道的那样去做。

sentences.en: And even then, the nature of the relationship with the client and I've had this actually quite a few times, the complaint has been made by a vulnerable patient of a psychologist
sentences.zh: 即便如此，客户与我之间的关系性质——我实际上已经遇到过好几次了——投诉是由心理学家的一个弱势病人提出的，

sentences.en: who is absolutely distraught that this psychologist leaving them.
sentences.zh: 他绝对心烦意乱，因为这个心理学家离开了他。

sentences.en: And this leads to a lot of anger, a lot of revisionism.
sentences.zh: 这导致了大量的愤怒和历史修正主义。

sentences.en: So suddenly a lot of the practice, a lot of the work that they did together is viewed through a different prism and they now accuse them of inappropriate touching.
sentences.zh: 所以突然间，他们一起度过的许多实践和许多工作都被通过不同的棱镜来看待，他们现在指责他们有不适当的触碰。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a more extreme case, but they can definitely say that you left me abandoned and they're angry.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个更极端的例子，但他们绝对可以说你抛弃了我，而且他们很生气。

sentences.en: And then they can write, and I've seen this with my work with the HCPC and actually with a recent client, they can write very, very structured letters to the HCPC
sentences.zh: 然后他们可以写信——我在我与HCPC的工作中以及实际上与最近的一位客户身上都见过这种情况——他们可以给HCPC写非常非常结构化的信件

sentences.en: as part of the complaint process, explaining in great detail what this person did wrong.
sentences.zh: 作为投诉流程的一部分，详细解释这个人做错了什么。

sentences.en: And if you're the HCPC, you're receiving this, it's well structured.
sentences.zh: 如果你是HCPC，你收到这个，它结构很好。

sentences.en: This person may not necessarily have a psychiatric disorder, but clearly is motivated because they had this personal relationship with this client, with this psychologist, sorry.
sentences.zh: 这个人可能不一定有精神障碍，但显然是出于动机，因为他们与这个客户、对不起，与这个心理学家有着这种私人关系。

sentences.en: And they can write pages of very organized reasons why their psychologist has done something wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们可以写上好几页组织得很好的理由，说明他们的心理学家做错了什么。

sentences.en: The HCPC is just reading prima facie what's in front of them.
sentences.zh: HCPC只是在表面上阅读他们面前的东西。

sentences.en: And they will essentially have to look at these complaints and take them on face value.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上必须查看这些投诉并按表面价值接受它们。

sentences.en: And you may know as a psychologist, you've done absolutely nothing wrong.
sentences.zh: 作为一个心理学家，你可能知道自己绝对没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: The HCPC are doing their job.
sentences.zh: HCPC在履行他们的职责。

sentences.en: They're saying everyone deserves to have their right, you know, maybe everyone deserves to have their complaint heard.
sentences.zh: 他们说每个人都应该拥有自己的权利，你知道，也许每个人都应该有权倾听他们的投诉。

sentences.en: So that looks quite clearly like a case that's going to pass the triage stage.
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来很明显是一个将通过分诊阶段的案件。

sentences.en: That's going to go to an investigation, even though there's substantially nothing in it.
sentences.zh: 这将进入调查阶段，尽管实质上里面什么也没有。

sentences.en: And the psychologists,
sentences.zh: 而心理学家们，

sentences.en: particularly if they have experience,
sentences.zh: 特别是如果他们有经验的话，

sentences.en: will know that what they've done is correct.
sentences.zh: 会知道他们所做的是正确的。

sentences.en: And they've done it.
sentences.zh: 而且他们已经做了。

sentences.en: Their note-taking's fine.
sentences.zh: 他们的记录做得很不错。

sentences.en: Everything's fine.
sentences.zh: 一切都很好。

sentences.en: They know this patient.
sentences.zh: 他们了解这位患者。

sentences.en: But you can't just respond to the HCPC saying this patient has these major mental health issues or this patient has this attachment
sentences.zh: 但你不能只是对HCPC回应说这个患者有这些重大的心理健康问题，或者这个患者有这种依恋

sentences.en: issue to do with their childhood.
sentences.zh: 与其童年有关的问题。

sentences.en: It doesn't work like that.
sentences.zh: 事情不是这样的。

sentences.en: So then the investigation process starts.
sentences.zh: 于是调查程序就开始了。

sentences.en: So as I've explained to psychologists quite often, the fact that psychologists are the second most investigated profession of all HCPC regulated
sentences.zh: 正如我经常向心理学家们解释的那样，在所有受HCPC监管的职业中，

sentences.en: professions is to me interesting.
sentences.zh: 心理学家是被调查频率第二高的职业，这让我觉得很有意思。

sentences.en: So paramedics and psychologists are the two professions which have most complaints raised against them.
sentences.zh: 所以，医护急救人员和心理学家是收到投诉最多的两个职业。

sentences.en: Now, that doesn't mean more psychologists are struck off than anyone else.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并不意味着被除名的心理学家比其他人更多。

sentences.en: It just means that the nature of profession, I would argue, vulnerable people make these complaints and they can make multiple complaints against multiple people.
sentences.zh: 我的理解是，这只是由该职业的性质决定的：弱势群体会提出这些投诉，而且他们可能会针对多个人提出多起投诉。

sentences.en: And so it's worth understanding that these sort of people of these patients, these people
sentences.zh: 因此，值得理解的是，这类人，也就是这些患者，这些与你工作相关的人

sentences.en: involved in your work can also, if the relationship breaks down, can react negatively.
sentences.zh: 如果关系破裂，也会做出消极的反应。

sentences.en: So be aware of that is what I'd argue.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，对此要有清醒的认识。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: That's really helped me to kind of get an understanding with that example of how that might crop up for vulnerable patients.
sentences.zh: 通过这个例子，我真的对弱势患者可能会遇到这种问题有了很好的理解。

sentences.en: In order for us to kind of get an understanding of other examples where this might crop up for other referrals, have you got any other examples you could share, Nick?
sentences.zh: 为了让我们对其他转诊可能遇到的其他例子有所了解，尼克，你还有什么其他例子可以分享吗？

sentences.en: I think what might be most relevant is to give you some examples of cases that may affect a broader group of people.
sentences.zh: 我认为最相关的可能是举一些可能影响更广泛人群的案例。

sentences.en: So everyone knows there's black and white cases.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道有些事情是黑白分明的。

sentences.en: So there's clearly professional boundaries issues, having a sexual relationship with a client, these sort of things that are clearly going to get you struck off.
sentences.zh: 比如明显的职业界限问题，与客户发生性关系，这些都是显然会导致你被除名的事情。

sentences.en: There's no question about that.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: That's the sort of thing that you see on every single drama as well.
sentences.zh: 这也是你在每一部电视剧里都能看到的情节。

sentences.en: But actually, as a psychologist watching those dramas, it makes us scream at the telly because you're like, ah, this never happens.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，作为一名心理学家看那些电视剧时，我们会气得对着电视尖叫，因为你会觉得，啊，这根本不可能发生。

sentences.en: You know, it's always a psychologist who's the murderer or who's unethical.
sentences.zh: 你知道，总是心理学家成了凶手或者不够职业。

sentences.en: And in the most case, that is not my experience of the professions.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，这并不是我对这个行业的体验。

sentences.en: Let me just leave that there.
sentences.zh: 我就把话放在这里。

sentences.en: But on occasion, it does happen and it's a serious concern.
sentences.zh: 但有时确实会发生，这是一个严重的问题。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, it does happen.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这确实会发生。

sentences.en: I mean, when I was working with the HCPC, I would be prosecuting these cases, but they're rare.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当我还在HCPC工作时，我会负责起诉这些案件，但它们很少见。

sentences.en: They're very rare.
sentences.zh: 它们非常罕见。

sentences.en: They're not the ones that clog up the system.
sentences.zh: 它们并不是那些堵塞系统的事情。

sentences.en: You know, they're definitely not the complex.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它们绝对不是复杂的案件。

sentences.en: They're not complicated because it's black and white, really, unless there's a denial of that relationship or whatever it may be.
sentences.zh: 它们并不复杂，因为这实际上是黑白分明的，除非有人否认这种关系或诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: But for me, the issues that people may face in a daily basis relate to two, sort of two areas.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，人们在日常生活中可能面临的问题涉及两个，可以说是两个方面。

sentences.en: One I'd say is scope of practice.
sentences.zh: 一个我想说是执业范围。

sentences.en: So whether you are actually fully qualified to undertake the particular role that you're undertaking, that is something that crops up, I wouldn't say very regularly,
sentences.zh: 也就是说，你是否真正完全具备资格来承担你所担任的特定角色，这种情况偶尔会出现，我不能说非常频繁，

sentences.en: but it's something that I've seen quite often.
sentences.zh: 但这是我相当常见到的情况。

sentences.en: So what that means, and I'll give you an example to illustrate the point.
sentences.zh: 这意味着什么呢，我举个例子来阐明这一点。

sentences.en: I had a client recently who acted on a parole board in a juvenile setting.
sentences.zh: 我最近有一个客户，他在一个少年管教机构的假释委员会工作。

sentences.en: So he's in a juvenile prison and this particular client was sitting on the body that's decided whether this person was likely to re-offend.
sentences.zh: 所以他在一所少管所里，这个特定的客户是决定此人是否容易再次犯罪的评议机构成员之一。

sentences.en: Now, they wrote a report.
sentences.zh: 他们写了一份报告。

sentences.en: The report they thought was fine.
sentences.zh: 他们认为报告写得很好。

sentences.en: There was no complaints about it.
sentences.zh: 没有任何投诉。

sentences.en: That inmate,
sentences.zh: 那个被收监的

sentences.en: juvenile, was released and then committed a crime.
sentences.zh: 未成年人被释放后又犯罪了。

sentences.en: Now, you work backwards from these steps and that report became under analysis.
sentences.zh: 现在，你顺着这些步骤倒推，那份报告就遭到了分析。

sentences.en: So essentially, the report that was written by a psychologist who said purported to be an expert in this area was now scrutinized.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，由一名声称自己是该领域专家的心理学家所写的报告现在受到了审查。

sentences.en: And under scrutiny, it came quite clear that they didn't have the appropriate training.
sentences.zh: 而在审查之下，很明显他们并没有接受过适当的培训。

sentences.en: Now, certain things, certain areas of psychology are quite niche, as you guys all know, but it is quite a broad spectrum of professions.
sentences.zh: 某些事情，心理学的某些领域非常小众，大家也都知道，但它其实是一个相当广泛的专业领域。

sentences.en: So you can have an area of expertise in one area that overlaps.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能在一个领域有专业知识，而这又与其他领域重叠。

sentences.en: Where one starts, one stops is quite blurred.
sentences.zh: 哪里开始，哪里结束，界限相当模糊。

sentences.en: That's the nature of the profession.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个行业的性质。

sentences.en: Someone can have a great deal of experience in one area which becomes highly relevant to a second one.
sentences.zh: 一个人可能在某一领域有大量的经验，而这些经验与第二个领域高度相关。

sentences.en: Now, I would argue having read the report and analyzed the report this person wrote, it was excellent.
sentences.zh: 现在，我认为在读过并分析了这个人写的报告后，它非常出色。

sentences.en: There was no question it was an excellent report.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，这是一份极好的报告。

sentences.en: But, working backwards, it became clear in this particular field, you needed to have a particular qualification, this particular area of training.
sentences.zh: 但是，倒推来看，在这个特定的领域，很显然你需要具备特定的资格、特定的培训领域。

sentences.en: Seven-day course, ten-day course, you needed to have written, I can't remember the exact details as a while ago.
sentences.zh: 为期七天的课程，十天课程，你需要写过——我记不清具体细节了，那是段较早前的事情了。

sentences.en: Like, you need to be trained in expert witness work.
sentences.zh: 就像，你需要接受过专家证人工作的培训。

sentences.en: Is that kind of an example?
sentences.zh: 这算是一种例子吗？

sentences.en: It's part of it.
sentences.zh: 这是其中一部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, so you needed to be, you needed to have a specific document to be able to work within the sphere of juvenile detention centres.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以你需要具备特定的一份文件，才能在少年拘留中心这一领域内工作。

sentences.en: It's even that niche.
sentences.zh: 甚至就是这么小众。

sentences.en: So, this specific area.
sentences.zh: 所以，是这个特定领域。

sentences.en: This isn't about representing someone in court, this is about actually you need that qualification, that experience to be able to do that piece of work and you haven't got it,
sentences.zh: 这并不是指在法庭上代表某人，而是指实际上你需要这种资格、这种经验才能完成那项工作，而你没有，

sentences.en: so you shouldn't be doing it.
sentences.zh: 所以你不应该去做。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And so, this could have been solved quite easy and this person was very professional and very good and that my client was highly competent.
sentences.zh: 所以，这本可以很容易地解决，而且这个人非常专业、非常优秀，我的客户能力也很强。

sentences.en: There was no issues with that but because they didn't have this one thing which they were required, that became an HGPC case that went quite far.
sentences.zh: 这方面没有任何问题，但因为他们缺少了这个被要求的环节，这就变成了一个发展得相当严重的HCPC案件。

sentences.en: So, what I'd explain
sentences.zh: 所以，我向

sentences.en: to people when I'm giving webinars I say this quite often is if you're unsure, talk to your supervisor,
sentences.zh: 人们解释时——当我做网络研讨会时我经常这么说——如果你不确定，去和你的主管谈谈，

sentences.en: look it up, look to see if I'm going to act on behalf of someone or if I'm going to
sentences.zh: 查阅一下，看看我是否要代表某人行事，或者我是否要

sentences.en: purport to be a particular expert particularly say in educational psychology or forensic psychology and if you do have a good understanding of this, just make sure
sentences.zh: 自称为某个特定领域的专家，特别是比如在教育心理学或法医心理学领域，如果你对此有很好的理解，只要确保

sentences.en: that your documentation is in line with what you're purporting to do.
sentences.zh: 你的文档记录与你声称要做的事情相符。

sentences.en: Now, it seems similar because in most circumstances there's not really that set requirement but in certain areas be aware that you're not acting outside of your scope of practice.
sentences.zh: 现在，这看起来很相似，因为在大多数情况下并没有那种硬性要求，但在某些领域，要注意不要超出你的执业范围。

sentences.en: So, that's one area that I think is worth just being aware of.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是我认为值得注意的一个领域。

sentences.en: It's not something you'd like you to encounter every day and most people know what they know and they stick within their areas but if you're just like, hey, wait a second,
sentences.zh: 这不是那种你每天都会遇到的事情，大多数人也知道自己懂什么，并且坚守在自己的领域内，但如果你只是觉得，等等，

sentences.en: I'm not sure
sentences.zh: 我不确定

sentences.en: I'm quite the right person to do this and I know in a world where income is really important, just be careful that you don't take that role unless you're fully qualified
sentences.zh: 我是做这件事最合适的人选吗？而且我知道在一个收入非常重要的世界里，请务必小心，除非你完全具备资格，

sentences.en: to take that role.
sentences.zh: 否则不要承担那个角色。

sentences.en: So, that'd be sort of the first area that I'd mention.
sentences.zh: 所以，这将是我要提到的第一个方面。

sentences.en: Another one would be in terms of reporting.
sentences.zh: 另一个方面与报告（上报）有关。

sentences.en: If you feel, for example, like someone you work with is doing something inappropriate, someone within your, another professional that you have contact with is doing something
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得，例如，与你共事的人在做不适当的事情，你圈子里的某个人、你接触的另一个专业人士在做

sentences.en: that they shouldn't be doing, it's a good idea to seek advice from your supervisor immediately and then if you both agree that this should be reported,
sentences.zh: 他们不应该做的事情，最好立即向你的主管寻求建议，然后如果你们一致认为应该上报，

sentences.en: reported as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 那就尽快上报。

sentences.en: Now, the example I give is a case I had a while back where a woman who runs a clinic and has psychologists working within her clinic but it's sort of a sub-let agreement
sentences.zh: 现在我举的例子是我不久前遇到的一起案件：一个女性经营着一家诊所，诊所里有心理学家工作，但有点像转租协议，

sentences.en: but it's under her name so they're all experts in this particular area of psychology.
